searches.phase_reflection: Remote/local handoff should stay artifact-backed and reversible.
searches.runner_implication: Keep handoff receipts small and route remote work through explicit branch/current-state anchors.

searches.phase_reflection: Local skills are the right home for startup, compact-pause, and closeout operating rules.
searches.runner_implication: Validate edited skills before publishing phase truth.

searches.phase_reflection: Command surfaces should be explicit and recoverable rather than hidden in chat memory.
searches.runner_implication: Prefer named runner and command entrypoints for repeatable phase work.

searches.phase_reflection: Worktree isolation supports omega-mini publication and full-tools support separation.
searches.runner_implication: Keep sanitized publication worktree and richer support lane distinct.

searches.phase_reflection: Identifier control needs verifiable boundaries and controller separation.
searches.runner_implication: Keep identity work as design/research until exact approval and compliance review.

searches.phase_reflection: Credential claims need issuer, holder, subject, and proof semantics separated.
searches.runner_implication: Model CBR claims as schema candidates, not as proof closure.

searches.phase_reflection: Reader-facing identity explanations benefit from a plain overview layer.
searches.runner_implication: Create compact primer artifacts before any implementation-heavy identity lane.

searches.phase_reflection: Integrity proofs are protocol details that must not be hand-waved.
searches.runner_implication: Queue cryptographic binding work behind exact approval.

searches.phase_reflection: Identity assurance, authentication, and federation should be treated as separate risk lanes.
searches.runner_implication: Add assurance-level vocabulary to candidate packets.

searches.phase_reflection: Authentication claims and tokens need standard protocol mapping.
searches.runner_implication: Keep any account/auth changes exact-approval only.

searches.phase_reflection: Authorization grants are a different lane from identity proof.
searches.runner_implication: Separate authz design packets from identity/canon packets.

searches.phase_reflection: Token claims are compact but easy to over-trust.
searches.runner_implication: Queue token validation and key handling as exact-approval implementation work.

searches.phase_reflection: AI orchestration should keep govern/map/measure/manage loops visible.
searches.runner_implication: Add risk-loop labels to approval packets and closeouts.

searches.phase_reflection: Runner orchestration needs explicit child process and stream boundaries.
searches.runner_implication: Prefer Node entrypoints with summarized stdout/stderr counts.

searches.phase_reflection: Python runners should preserve argument boundaries and avoid shell interpolation.
searches.runner_implication: Keep Python helpers for validation/gate work where already established.

searches.phase_reflection: Multiple lanes need clean worktree state rather than stateful directory reuse.
searches.runner_implication: Check branch/worktree truth before phase publication.

searches.phase_reflection: CI ideas should stay candidate until repo workflow mutation is approved.
searches.runner_implication: Classify workflow edits as exact-approval unless purely local docs.

searches.phase_reflection: Long-running orchestration benefits from structured traces, spans, and attributes.
searches.runner_implication: Propose local status schema improvements before telemetry installation.

searches.phase_reflection: Controller reconciliation is a strong analogy for updater and cadence runners.
searches.runner_implication: Design runners as reconcile loops with observed, desired, and gap states.

searches.phase_reflection: Browser automation must prefer robust locators and auto-waiting.
searches.runner_implication: If browser handoff resumes, keep it locator-driven and receipt-backed.

searches.phase_reflection: Background Windows tasks need explicit lifecycle and harvest semantics.
searches.runner_implication: Use detached/background runner receipts rather than terminal babysitting.

searches.phase_reflection: Scholar APIs can support bounded literature discovery.
searches.runner_implication: Queue API harvesters as candidate until rate limits and provenance are validated.

searches.phase_reflection: DOI metadata can help canonicalize research ledgers.
searches.runner_implication: Add citation normalization as a safe skill/runner idea.

searches.phase_reflection: Open bibliographic graphs can broaden GMUT literature maps.
searches.runner_implication: Keep imported metadata compact and source-labelled.

searches.phase_reflection: Physics paper discovery should be queryable and reproducible.
searches.runner_implication: Use arXiv manifests for GMUT exploratory queues without claiming closure.
